description: Phase 5: Add start_offset_secs parameter to video generation so users can regenerate preview videos starting from a custom timecode (e.g. 1:30 into the track).

steps.task: Add `start_offset_secs: u32` parameter to `compose_video` in video.rs (line 389). Before the audio input `-i track`, add `-ss {start_offset_secs}` to the FFmpeg command args to seek into the audio. Only add `-ss` if start_offset_secs > 0. The `-ss` flag should be placed before the `-i` for the audio input (input seeking, not output seeking) for fast seeking.

decisions: Input seeking (-ss before -i) is faster than output seeking (-ss after -i)
Only add -ss if offset > 0 to preserve current behavior for default case
learnings: compose_video is at lines 389-478 of video.rs
FFmpeg command structure: -loop 1 -i image -t N -i track -filter_complex ... -c:v libx264 -c:a aac
The -t flag controls duration (always 30 seconds), -ss controls start position

steps.task: Add `start_offset_secs: u32` parameter to `generate_track_preview_video` (line 56) and `generate_inner` (private helper called by it). Thread the parameter down to compose_video. The public API signature becomes: `pub async fn generate_track_preview_video(state, artist_image_key, track_key, _peaks_key, duration_secs, start_offset_secs) -> Result<Vec<u8>>`.

learnings: It calls generate_inner which calls compose_video

steps.task: Update all existing call sites of `generate_track_preview_video` to pass `0` for the new `start_offset_secs` parameter. Locations: (1) video.rs line ~145 in `generate_and_store_artist_videos` and (2) instagram.rs in `post_artist_to_instagram` on-demand video generation fallback (search for `generate_track_preview_video` in instagram.rs).

decisions: Passing 0 preserves existing behavior (no seeking, start from beginning)
knowledge.notes: Search all .rs files for generate_track_preview_video to find all call sites

steps.task: Add helper function `parse_timecode(input: &str) -> Result<u32, String>` in telegram.rs (or video.rs). Parses user timecode input: '1:30' → 90, '0:45' → 45, '90' → 90, '0' → 0. Returns seconds as u32. Handle invalid input with a descriptive error message.

decisions: Place in telegram.rs since it's only used by the Telegram callback flow
Support both M:SS and plain seconds formats
